method: prop=revisions (rvstart=2022-11-29T23:59:59Z, rvdir=older, rvlimit=1) to pick the newest revision strictly before the cutoff, then action=parse&oldid=<revid>&prop=wikitext, then the conservative cleaner in tools/fetch-corpus.js cleanWikitext(). prop=extracts is NOT used: TextExtracts ignores revids/oldid and returns the current revision, verified against ar.wikipedia revid 1623 (2004-02-25), which returned the current extract byte for byte. Each cleaned document is then trimmed at a paragraph boundary to its leading 600 Arabic words; sha256 is the hash of the trimmed text as stored under raw/.
